auc.accepted: non-empty finite probabilities in [0,1] with binary outcomes
auc.constant_predictions: returns 0.5 when both outcome classes exist

bootstrap.accepted: exact domain sizes 216/216/280; finite paired metric values; chronological kickoff batches; at least 10 batches

brier.accepted: finite probabilities in [0,1] with binary outcomes
brier.empty_missing_non_finite: fail closed at enclosing evidence contract

calibration_intercept_slope.accepted: finite probabilities in (0,1), aligned binary outcomes containing both classes
calibration_intercept_slope.boundaries: only provider-labelled own-goal xG=0/outcome=1 is separated and counted; every other boundary fails closed
calibration_intercept_slope.constant_predictions: accepted only if optimization and finite covariance converge

crps.accepted: finite non-negative normalized score distribution with unresolved tail <=1e-12
crps.boundaries: zero atom probabilities accepted; total mass must remain one

descriptive_npxg.accepted: finite raw xG in [0,1]; exact zeros retained
descriptive_npxg.boundaries: retained for counts, mean, quantiles, KS and situation summaries
descriptive_npxg.empty_groups: fail closed for required domain summary; absent optional situation pairs are omitted

heterogeneity.accepted: non-empty required domains with finite raw xG and aligned semantic category flags
heterogeneity.boundaries: own-goal xG=0 separated only for logit calibration; unchanged for all other diagnostics

intervals.accepted: finite normalized non-negative discrete total-goal distribution and levels 0.5/0.9
intervals.boundaries: zero/one cumulative values accepted when requested quantiles resolve

log_loss.accepted: finite normalized distributions with strictly positive probability on the observed event
log_loss.probability_zero_on_observed_event: fail closed instead of publishing infinity
log_loss.probability_one_on_observed_event: valid zero loss when distribution normalization is valid

reliability_bins.accepted: aligned finite probabilities in [0,1] with binary outcomes; empty input yields ten empty bins
reliability_bins.boundaries: 0 maps to first bin; 1 maps to final bin; no clipping
